concerns.text: Task T028 (schema definition for metrics.csv) is marked incomplete, yet dependent implementation tasks T026 (MAE calculation) and T027 (SfM failure handling) explicitly require this schema to write output. This creates a circular dependency where the data writer cannot run because the schema producer has not emitted the artifact. T028 must precede T026 and T027.

Task T023a (video generation) produces MP4 files but depends on the target directory `data/derived/videos/` created by T023b. T023b is marked incomplete. A producer (T023a) cannot run before its required directory artifact (T023b) exists. T023b must precede T023a.

Task T037 (schema definition for statistical_results.json) is marked incomplete, yet dependent tasks T034 (censoring rate), T036 (Wilcoxon test), T039b (sufficiency ratio), and T039c (sensitivity table) all require this schema to write their output artifacts. T037 must precede all statistical writing tasks.

Task T033b (Constitution Amendment Request) is a prerequisite for the validity of T033 (McNemar/Wilcoxon implementation) and T036 (Wilcoxon test) because the Constitution Principle VI mandates a 'paired t-test'. The plan explicitly notes this conflict. The amendment request (T033b) must be completed and approved before the statistical tests (T033, T036) can be validly implemented to avoid violating the Constitution.

Task T001 lists 15 directories to verify, but the path `projects/PROJ-llmxive-follow-up-extending-dreamx-world` (missing '886-') is inconsistent with the project root `projects/PROJ-886-llmxive-follow-up-extending-dreamx-world` used in all other tasks. This creates a potential execution failure where the verification script checks the wrong path.
